utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I still need help sorting donations and setting up the porch tables Saturday. If you can come by around 9, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll be there around 9 to help sort donations and set up the porch tables for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Vik. See you Saturday around 9.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I’m telling folks to head there instead. I’ll keep spreading the word around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know — I’ll spread the word too and tell folks it’s at the community center on Sunday now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you spreading the word too. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Gus—Sunday at the community center works. I’ll update the plan and still could use your help there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Gus—I really appreciate it. I’ll bring the updated supplies list, and we’ll get everything set up Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center now. I’ll bring the list, and I can send a reminder if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — Sunday at the community center works for me. Bring the list when you can, and I’ll check my shed for tools once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll bring the list by and I’ll send a quick reminder if it looks like you need one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I’ll bring my toolbox and a roll of duct tape on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah—that’ll be a big help. See you Saturday at the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: You got it—see you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so that’s the plan I’m following. Once the details are confirmed, I can line up what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — Sunday at the community center helps, but I still want the start time and drop-off spot confirmed before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That makes sense, Pia. I’ll wait for the start time and drop-off spot to be confirmed before I set anything in stone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on Saturday at the front porch, right? What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, Saturday at the front porch is still the plan. If you can bring tools or spare parts, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—I'll bring some tools and any spare parts I can find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Main thing? I could really use a couple more helpers for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A couple more helpers sounds good—I can ask around and see who can make it Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d be a big help. If you can get even one or two people, I’ll be set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re set up on the front porch this Saturday, and I could use help with the tables and sorting the repair items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, do we have enough volunteers for the tables and sorting yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’ve got a couple helpers, but I could still use one more pair of hands for the tables if you know anyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s still shaping up nicely—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts, and I’m happy to pass along any last-minute updates.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s good to hear—could you let everyone know we still need a couple more helpers for Saturday at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word that we still need a couple more helpers for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, see you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, it’s this Saturday on the front porch—not Sunday at the community center. Hope you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for the update, Rey — I had it down as Sunday at the community center, so I’ll check which time is correct and let folks know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community center. I can send the full details and help work around the school schedule if you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, great — thanks, Faye. The community center on Sunday works; please send the full details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send them over now, and we can adjust for the school schedule if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s set for Saturday on the front porch. If you can help, I could use a hand setting up and directing folks there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help set up and direct people to the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — that’s a big help. I’ll count on you at the front porch Saturday for setup and directing folks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell. I’m hoping a few neighbors can lend a hand on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot, but I’ll spread the word about Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell. I’ll make sure people know it’s the front porch, and I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the community center on Sunday now. I’d keep it simple and head there then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the update — I’ll shift the repair drive to the community center on Sunday and keep it simple. I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right—Sunday at the community center should keep things easy. Thanks for letting everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Kira — I could use help setting up the front porch tables and sorting repair items for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you want me helping with the front porch tables and sorting items this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right—if you can help with the front porch tables and sort the repair items this Saturday, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I’m telling folks around the block so it gets around fast.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for the update, Quinn — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara — the more folks know, the better. I’ll keep handing out invites around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for the update — so it’s Sunday at the community center now, right? I’ll make sure I’ve got that noted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Actually, it’s this Saturday at the front porch, not Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Saturday at the front porch. Thanks for correcting me; I’ll note that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — just a quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Let me know if you want a task to take on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — 10 AM at the community center works for me. I can help with check-in and sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Pia — thanks so much. I’ll put you down for check-in and donation sorting at 10 AM Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Sunday at the community center is the right spot. Sounds like they got a solid turnout, and I’m glad folks are still pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—sounds like it really came together. If you still need anything hauled over, I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I think they’re set on the hauling for now, but I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—bring the list by and I’ll take a look in my shed and see who can help with the repair drive. I may need a reminder, but I’m happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll bring the list by and remind you, then we can see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Vik. Bring it by and I’ll see what I can round up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still a little short on volunteers—can you help this Saturday at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can help this Saturday at the front porch. What time do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Leo—can you be there at 9 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — that would be a big help. I’m keeping it Sunday at the community center, so I’ll make sure the school schedule lines up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep sharing the word and point folks to Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you need any extra help lining up the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll send out the school-schedule details and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just sorting out the items and setting up the porch for Saturday. If you can help greet people or test a few repairs, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — I’ll help greet folks and test a few repairs on Saturday.
